tiers.label: Needs you
tiers.rule: Material by default: results, unusual moves, top-level people changes, M&A, litigation, fund raises, pledging, rating downgrades.

tiers.label: Worth knowing
tiers.rule: Useful but not urgent: orders, dividends, transcripts, smaller people changes, and anything no rule recognised.

tiers.label: Routine
tiers.rule: Compliance paperwork and meeting notices. Hidden, but listed at the bottom.
